location: San Nicolas de los Arroyos, Argentina

en.name: Our Lady of the Rosary of San Nicolas
en.summary: Series of apparitions beginning in 1983 to an Argentine laywoman, formally approved in 2016 after an extended canonical process.
en.body: Beginning in September 1983, an Argentine laywoman named Gladys Quiroga de Motta reported repeated apparitions of the Virgin Mary in the city of San Nicolas de los Arroyos, Argentina, continuing over many years and eventually numbering well over a thousand reported occurrences. Mary reportedly appeared as Our Lady of the Rosary, emphasizing prayer of the rosary, conversion, and peace, and devotion to the apparitions spread rapidly across Argentina, drawing large numbers of pilgrims to the site well before any formal Church ruling. Following a lengthy canonical investigation that examined the visionary's accounts, the messages received, and reported physical and spiritual fruits associated with the devotion, the local bishop formally declared the supernatural character of the apparitions in 2016, making San Nicolas one of the more recently approved Marian apparition sites recognized by the Church.
